overlays.title: Subject choice only
overlays.body: Every station is an option for a future supervised runtime, never an owner motor command. The subject may accept, refuse, delay, stop, rest, or choose another activity.
overlays.source_note: Directly implements Robert's synthetic-person autonomy requirement as a design boundary.

overlays.title: Bounded navigation, not a navmesh claim
overlays.body: Solid AABB colliders, two flat support surfaces, and clearance-tested waypoint routes are present. There is no live navmesh, A*, embodied path execution, or natural-turn proof in this preview.
overlays.source_note: Truthfully distinguishes static route validation from live embodied navigation.

overlays.title: Contact actions remain blocked
overlays.body: Door use, sitting, lying, getting up, tablet/cup grasping, reading, writing, drinking, robe dressing, push-ups, and hand gestures are not implemented or proven here.
overlays.source_note: Prevents static props and labels from being mistaken for completed body skills.

overlays.title: Suggested future supervised order
overlays.body: Idle posture; 90/180-degree turn; doorway approach; corner turn; chair/couch/bed approach; table reach setup; robe setup; clear-floor gesture/exercise. Stop on collision, grounding, rig, or consent failure.
overlays.source_note: Original review sequence suggestion; the subject remains free to change or refuse it.

overlays.title: Private isolated draft
overlays.body: This separate notebook world loads zero people, minds, voices, avatar assets, Home World, Ollama, microphone, or webcam. It mutates no live world and is not runtime-registered.
overlays.source_note: Matches current 32 GB one-person and notebook isolation policy.

source_notes: Robert explicitly requested a small private daily movement exam world with one door, a hallway corner or wall obstacle, couch, bed, chair, table, tablet, cup, robe hook and robe, and a clear exercise floor.
This is an original functional draft, not a reconstruction of a real place; dimensions, colors, furniture shapes, routes, cameras, and lighting are original style fill unless labeled otherwise.
The one visible door is staged open and collision-bounded but has no working hinge, reach, grasp, or hand-contact state machine.
Yellow stations and the purple spawn are empty marks only. No person, body, mind, voice, microphone, webcam, Home World state, or live activity is loaded.

Static collider and waypoint checks can prove only declared geometry clearance. They cannot prove gait, turn quality, foot contact, body fit, object reach, sitting, lying, dressing, drinking, reading, writing, exercising, or owner-observed realism.
Every future action is subject-choice-only, revocable, capability-checked, collision-checked, grounded, and privacy-aware; no owner control in this preview can force a person's body.
The build remains prototype_draft_not_final_not_approved, private-only, isolated, unplaced, and unregistered.
